name: g1
_note: G1 stand driven by the SAMPLING-MPC brain (projects/policies/control/g1_mpc_stand.py) instead of the reactive lean/arm/trim overlays. Enable with HSTAND_MPC=1. NOMINAL = the trainer's reconciled deeper squat (hip -0.30/knee 0.52/ankle -0.23, gpu_mjwarp_g1_walk_trainer NOMINAL) + ank_bias -0.10 (the proven Newton CoM-back centering), which is the closest pose held by BOTH the kp400 MuJoCo planning sidecar (g1_full) AND the Newton deploy. The MPC reads the live Newton state each tick, rolls the sidecar forward, and returns leg+shoulder targets; the reactive overlays below are DISABLED so the MPC is the sole balancer. STATUS (honest): this got the in-Newton MPC from FALL@1.25s (gait pose) to a clean ~2.5s stand (rest FALL@2.67s, first-cube FALL@1.63s). It does NOT yet stand durably in Newton -- the residual CPU-MuJoCo(sidecar) vs mujoco_warp(Newton) DYNAMIC mismatch tips it; an integral/foot-shift can't fix a dynamic (not static) gap. Opt-in experimental knobs for closing it further: HSTAND_MPC_FOOTSHIFT (shift sidecar foot to match the importer), HSTAND_MPC_TRIM (offset-free setpoint integral), HSTAND_MPC_PLANT=deploy + HSTAND_MPC_KP/KD (use the deploy-derived MJCF as the sidecar). The definitive fix is planning in mujoco_warp in-process (same engine as deploy).
